text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bosnian prime minister Hasan Muratovic asks president of the World Bank to increase credit for Bosnia-Herzegovina.
- Bosnian president and president of the Bosnian Moslem-Croat Federation have appointed General Rasim Delic as commander of a new joint Moslem-Croat army.
- Patrick Bradley, chief electoral officer from Ireland, will serve as a new director-general for elections in Bosnia, OSCE reported.
- Bosnian miners end strike after government promises payment of August salaries.
- An elderly Bosnian man was murdered by unknown assailants in the zone of separation in northeast Bosnia on Tuesday, international police in Bosnia reported. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
